examples.text: Todas las promesas de mi amor se irán contigo / Me olvidarás, me olvidarás
examples.translation: All the promises of my love will leave with you / You'll forget me, you'll forget me

examples.english: Hildebranda was not to ever forget her first sight of the man that appeared on the stirrup, ...
